proposals.evidence: CDIAL 14021 hásati explicitly gives Kumaoni hãsṇo, Maithili hasab/hãsab, Bhojpuri hãsal and Hindi hasnā. The bare has/hãs laugh responses fit this verb, with nasalisation variation explicitly documented in the family. No additional negative, auxiliary or suffix-bearing material is included in these targets. Local Indo-Aryan transmission remains open. Exact response: hãs.
